				<div id="mw-content-text" class="mw-body-content"><div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" lang="en" dir="ltr"><figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/wiki/File:Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/2e/Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png/300px-Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="118" class="mw-file-element" srcset="https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/2e/Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png/450px-Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png 1.5x, https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/2/2e/Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png/600px-Ash_Pok%C3%A9mon_injured.png 2x" data-file-width="1280" data-file-height="502"></a><figcaption><a href="/wiki/Category:Ash%27s_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Category:Ash's Pokémon">Ash's Pokémon</a> injured after a battle</figcaption></figure>
<p><b>Damage</b> (Japanese: <b>ダメージ</b> <i>damage</i>) is a loss of a Pokémon's <a href="/wiki/HP" title="HP">HP</a> that happens as the result of a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical</a> or <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special</a> <a href="/wiki/Move" title="Move">attack</a> used against it by another Pokémon.
</p>

<div id="cls-video-container-GVPYOwFj" class="adthrive" style="min-height: 580.5px;"><div></div></div><h2><span class="mw-headline" id="In_the_core_series_games">In the core series games</span></h2>
<table align="center" style="margin: 3px auto; background: rgb(250, 255, 244); border: 2px solid rgb(145, 81, 33); border-radius: 40px;">

<tbody><tr>
<td style="background:#B88E6F; padding: 10px; border-radius: 40px; -moz-border-radius: 40px; -webkit-border-radius: 40px; -khtml-border-radius: 40px; -icab-border-radius: 40px; -o-border-radius: 40px;;" width="50px" align="center"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/wiki/File:0050Diglett.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a6/0050Diglett.png/50px-0050Diglett.png" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="50" height="50" class="mw-file-element" srcset="https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a6/0050Diglett.png/75px-0050Diglett.png 1.5x, https://archives.bulbagarden.net/media/upload/thumb/a/a6/0050Diglett.png/100px-0050Diglett.png 2x" data-file-width="758" data-file-height="758"></a></span>
</td>
<td style="padding-left:3px; padding-right:20px"><b>This section is incomplete.</b><br>Please feel free to edit this section to add missing information and complete it. <br><small>Reason: Anything that may have potentially been missed or inaccurate</small>
</td></tr></tbody></table> 
<p>Except for <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_deal_direct_damage" title="Category:Moves that deal direct damage">moves that deal direct damage</a>, the damage dealt when a Pokémon uses a damaging move depends on its <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a>, its effective Attack or Special Attack <a href="/wiki/Statistic" class="mw-redirect" title="Statistic">stat</a>, the opponent's effective Defense or Special Defense stat, and the move's effective <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a>. In addition, various factors of damage modification may also affect the damage dealt.
</p><p>More precisely, damage is calculated in each <a href="/wiki/Generation" title="Generation">Generation</a> as:
</p>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Generation_I">Generation I</span></h3>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>D</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>L</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>A</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">/</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>m</mi></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where:
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 2 for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, all modifiers are ignored, and the unmodified Attack or Special is used instead). If either this or <i>D</i> are greater than 255, both are divided by 4 and rounded down.</li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special stat of the target if the used move is an other <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, all modifiers are ignored, and the unmodified Defense or Special is used instead). If the move is physical and the target has <a href="/wiki/Reflect_(move)" title="Reflect (move)">Reflect</a> up, or if the move is special and the target has <a href="/wiki/Light_Screen_(move)" title="Light Screen (move)">Light Screen</a> up, this value is doubled (unless it is a critical hit). If the move is <a href="/wiki/Explosion_(move)" title="Explosion (move)">Explosion</a> or <a href="/wiki/Self-Destruct_(move)" title="Self-Destruct (move)">Selfdestruct</a>, this value is halved (rounded down, with a minimum of 1). If either this or <i>A</i> are greater than 255, both are divided by 4 and rounded down. Unlike future Generations, if this is 0, the division is not made equal to 0; rather, the game will try to <a href="/wiki/List_of_glitches_in_Generation_I#Division_by_0" title="List of glitches in Generation I">divide by 0</a> and softlock, hanging indefinitely until it is turned off.</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, and 1 if otherwise. Internally, it is recognized as an addition of the damage calculated thus far divided by 2, rounded down, then added to the damage calculated thus far.</li>
<li><i>Type1</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's type that comes first in the type matchup table, or only type if it only has one type. This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), 2 (super effective).</li>
<li><i>Type2</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's type that comes second in the type matchup table. This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), 2 (super effective). If the target only has one type, <i>Type2</i> is 1. If this would result in 0 damage, the calculation ends here and the move is stated to have missed, even if it would've hit.</li>
<li><i>random</i> is realized as a multiplication by a random uniformly distributed integer between 217 and 255 (inclusive), followed by an integer division by 255. If the calculated damage thus far is 1, <i>random</i> is always 1.</li></ul>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Generation_II">Generation II</span></h3>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>D</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>L</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>A</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">/</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>l</mi><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>K</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>W</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>B</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>D</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>b</mi><mi>l</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>g</mi></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where:
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon. If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>Level</i> is instead the level of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, if the target's Defense or Special Defense stat stage is greater than or equal to the attacker's Attack or Special Attack stat stage, all modifiers are ignored, and the unmodified Attack or Special is used instead). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>A</i> is instead the base Attack of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, all modifiers are ignored, and the unmodified Defense or Special is used instead). If the move is physical and the target has <a href="/wiki/Reflect_(move)" title="Reflect (move)">Reflect</a> up, or if the move is special and the target has <a href="/wiki/Light_Screen_(move)" title="Light Screen (move)">Light Screen</a> up, this value is doubled (unless it is a critical hit). If the move is <a href="/wiki/Explosion_(move)" title="Explosion (move)">Explosion</a> or <a href="/wiki/Self-Destruct_(move)" title="Self-Destruct (move)">Selfdestruct</a>, this value is halved (rounded down, with a minimum of 1). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>D</i> is instead the base Defense of the target.</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>Item</i> is 1.1  if the attacker is holding an <a href="/wiki/Category:Type-enhancing_held_items" title="Category:Type-enhancing held items">type-enhancing held item</a> corresponding to the attack type (for instance, the <a href="/wiki/Magnet" title="Magnet">Magnet</a> for an <a href="/wiki/Electric_(type)" title="Electric (type)">Electric-type</a> move). Otherwise, this value is simply 1.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 2 for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, and 1 otherwise. It is always is 1 if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Flail_(move)" title="Flail (move)">Flail</a>, <a href="/wiki/Reversal_(move)" title="Reversal (move)">Reversal</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a>.</li>
<li><i>TK</i> is 1, 2, or 3 for each successive hit of <a href="/wiki/Triple_Kick_(move)" title="Triple Kick (move)">Triple Kick</a>, or always 1 if the used move is not Triple Kick.</li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 1.5 if a <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water-type</a> move is being used during <a href="/wiki/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a> move during <a href="/wiki/Harsh_sunlight" title="Harsh sunlight">harsh sunlight</a>, and 0.5 if a Water-type move is used during harsh sunlight or <a href="/wiki/Solar_Beam_(move)" title="Solar Beam (move)">SolarBeam</a> or any Fire-type move during rain, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Badge</i> is 1.125  if the attacking Pokémon is controlled by the player and if the player has obtained the <a href="/wiki/Badge" title="Badge">Badge</a> corresponding to the used move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a>, and 1 otherwise. This bonus is not applied in link battles or the <a href="/wiki/Battle_Tower_(Generation_II)" title="Battle Tower (Generation II)">Battle Tower</a>.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, and 1 if otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Type</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a>. This can be 0.25, 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), 2, or 4 (super effective), depending on both the move's and target's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">types</a>. If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Struggle_(move)" title="Struggle (move)">Struggle</a>, <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>Type</i> is always 1.</li>
<li><i>MoveMod</i> can be (and if the used move is not any of these, <i>MoveMod</i> is 1):
<ul><li>If <a href="/wiki/Rollout_(move)" title="Rollout (move)">Rollout</a> is used, <math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="false" scriptlevel="0"><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></msup></mstyle></mrow></math>, where <i>n</i> is the amount of successful and consecutive hits of the move, up to 4 (for the fifth hit), and <i>d</i> is 1 if <a href="/wiki/Defense_Curl_(move)" title="Defense Curl (move)">Defense Curl</a> was used beforehand and 0 otherwise.</li>
<li>If <a href="/wiki/Fury_Cutter_(move)" title="Fury Cutter (move)">Fury Cutter</a> is used, <math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><msup><mn>2</mn><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>n</mi></mrow></msup></mstyle></mrow></math>, where <i>n</i> is the number of successful and consecutive uses of the move, up to 4.</li>
<li>If <a href="/wiki/Rage_(move)" title="Rage (move)">Rage</a> is used, an integer value corresponding to the Rage counter, i.e. the number of times the user of Rage has been damaged by an attack while using Rage.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>random</i> is realized as a multiplication by a random uniformly distributed integer between 217 and 255 (inclusive), followed by an integer division by 255. <i>random</i> is always 1 if <a href="/wiki/Flail_(move)" title="Flail (move)">Flail</a> or <a href="/wiki/Reversal_(move)" title="Reversal (move)">Reversal</a> is used.</li>
<li><i>DoubleDmg</i> is 2 if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Pursuit_(move)" title="Pursuit (move)">Pursuit</a> and the target is attempting to switch out, <a href="/wiki/Stomp_(move)" title="Stomp (move)">Stomp</a> and the target has previously used <a href="/wiki/Minimize_(move)" title="Minimize (move)">Minimize</a>, <a href="/wiki/Gust_(move)" title="Gust (move)">Gust</a> or <a href="/wiki/Twister_(move)" title="Twister (move)">Twister</a> and the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of <a href="/wiki/Fly_(move)" title="Fly (move)">Fly</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Earthquake_(move)" title="Earthquake (move)">Earthquake</a> or <a href="/wiki/Magnitude_(move)" title="Magnitude (move)">Magnitude</a> and the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of Dig, and 1 otherwise.</li></ul>

<p>where:
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon. If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>Level</i> is instead the level of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, negative Attack or Special Attack stat stages are ignored). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>A</i> is instead the base Attack of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, positive Defense or Special Defense stat stages are ignored). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>D</i> is instead the base Defense of the target.</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the effective <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>Burn</i> is 0.5 if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a>, its Ability is not <a href="/wiki/Guts_(Ability)" title="Guts (Ability)">Guts</a>, and the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Screen</i> is 0.5 if the used move is physical and <a href="/wiki/Reflect_(move)" title="Reflect (move)">Reflect</a> is present on the target's side of the field, or special and <a href="/wiki/Light_Screen_(move)" title="Light Screen (move)">Light Screen</a> is present. For a <a href="/wiki/Double_Battle" title="Double Battle">Double Battle</a>, <i>Screen</i> is instead 2/3, and 1 otherwise or if the used move lands a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>. However, if, in a Double Battle, when the move is executed, the only Pokémon on the target's side is the target, <i>Screen</i> remains as 0.5.</li>
<li><i>Targets</i> is 0.5 in <a href="/wiki/Double_Battle" title="Double Battle">Double Battles</a> if the move <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_target_all_adjacent_foes" title="Category:Moves that target all adjacent foes">targets both foes</a> (unless it <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_target_all_adjacent_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Category:Moves that target all adjacent Pokémon">targets all other Pokémon</a>, like <a href="/wiki/Earthquake_(move)" title="Earthquake (move)">Earthquake</a>, and only if there is more than one such target when the move is executed, regardless of whether the move actually hits or can hit all the targets), and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li>If the base damage after applying <i>Targets</i> is 0 and the move is physical the base damage is increased by 1.<sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 1.5 if a <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water-type</a> move is being used during <a href="/wiki/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a> move during <a href="/wiki/Harsh_sunlight" title="Harsh sunlight">harsh sunlight</a>, and 0.5 if a Water-type move is used during harsh sunlight, any Fire-type move during rain, or <a href="/wiki/SolarBeam_(move)" class="mw-redirect" title="SolarBeam (move)">SolarBeam</a> during any non-clear weather besides harsh sunlight, and 1 otherwise or if any Pokémon on the field have the Ability <a href="/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability)" title="Cloud Nine (Ability)">Cloud Nine</a> or <a href="/wiki/Air_Lock_(Ability)" title="Air Lock (Ability)">Air Lock</a>.</li>
<li><i>FF</i> is 1.5 if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a>, and the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Flash_Fire_(Ability)" title="Flash Fire (Ability)">Flash Fire</a> that has been activated by a Fire-type move, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Stockpile</i> is 1, 2, or 3 if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Spit_Up_(move)" title="Spit Up (move)">Spit Up</a>, depending on how many <a href="/wiki/Stockpile_(move)" title="Stockpile (move)">Stockpiles</a> have been used, or always 1 if the used move is not Spit Up.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 2 for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, and 1 otherwise. It is always 1 if <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a>, <a href="/wiki/Doom_Desire_(move)" title="Doom Desire (move)">Doom Desire</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Spit_Up_(move)" title="Spit Up (move)">Spit Up</a> is used, if the target's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Battle_Armor_(Ability)" title="Battle Armor (Ability)">Battle Armor</a> or <a href="/wiki/Shell_Armor_(Ability)" title="Shell Armor (Ability)">Shell Armor</a>, or if the battle is the first one against <a href="/wiki/Poochyena_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Poochyena (Pokémon)">Poochyena</a><b><sup class="noexcerpt"><a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Ruby_and_Sapphire_Versions" title="Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions"><span style="color:#CD2236;">R</span><span style="color:#3D51A7;">S</span></a></sup></b>/<a href="/wiki/Zigzagoon_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Zigzagoon (Pokémon)">Zigzagoon</a><b><sup class="noexcerpt"><a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Emerald_Version" title="Pokémon Emerald Version"><span style="color:#009652;">E</span></a></sup></b> or the capture tutorial where <a href="/wiki/Wally" title="Wally">Wally</a> catches a <a href="/wiki/Ralts_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Ralts (Pokémon)">Ralts</a>.</li>
<li><i>DoubleDmg</i> is 2 if the used move is (and 1 if the used move is not any of these moves):
<ul><li><a href="/wiki/Gust_(move)" title="Gust (move)">Gust</a> or <a href="/wiki/Twister_(move)" title="Twister (move)">Twister</a> and the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of <a href="/wiki/Fly_(move)" title="Fly (move)">Fly</a> or <a href="/wiki/Bounce_(move)" title="Bounce (move)">Bounce</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Stomp_(move)" title="Stomp (move)">Stomp</a>, <a href="/wiki/Needle_Arm_(move)" title="Needle Arm (move)">Needle Arm</a>, <a href="/wiki/Astonish_(move)" title="Astonish (move)">Astonish</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Extrasensory_(move)" title="Extrasensory (move)">Extrasensory</a> and the target has previously used <a href="/wiki/Minimize_(move)" title="Minimize (move)">Minimize</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Surf_(move)" title="Surf (move)">Surf</a> or <a href="/wiki/Whirlpool_(move)" title="Whirlpool (move)">Whirlpool</a> and the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of <a href="/wiki/Dive_(move)" title="Dive (move)">Dive</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Earthquake_(move)" title="Earthquake (move)">Earthquake</a> or <a href="/wiki/Magnitude_(move)" title="Magnitude (move)">Magnitude</a> and the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of <a href="/wiki/Dig_(move)" title="Dig (move)">Dig</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Pursuit_(move)" title="Pursuit (move)">Pursuit</a> and the target is attempting to <a href="/wiki/Recall" title="Recall">switch out</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Facade_(move)" title="Facade (move)">Facade</a> and the user is <a href="/wiki/Poison_(status_condition)" title="Poison (status condition)">poisoned</a>, <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Paralysis_(status_condition)" title="Paralysis (status condition)">paralyzed</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/SmellingSalt_(move)" class="mw-redirect" title="SmellingSalt (move)">SmellingSalt</a> and the target is <a href="/wiki/Paralysis_(status_condition)" title="Paralysis (status condition)">paralyzed</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Revenge_(move)" title="Revenge (move)">Revenge</a> and the attacker has been damaged by the target this turn.</li>
<li><a href="/wiki/Weather_Ball_(move)" title="Weather Ball (move)">Weather Ball</a>, there is non-clear <a href="/wiki/Weather" title="Weather">weather</a>, and no Pokémon on the field have the Ability <a href="/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability)" title="Cloud Nine (Ability)">Cloud Nine</a> or <a href="/wiki/Air_Lock_(Ability)" title="Air Lock (Ability)">Air Lock</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Charge</i> is 2 if the move is <a href="/wiki/Electric_(type)" title="Electric (type)">Electric-type</a> and <a href="/wiki/Charge_(move)" title="Charge (move)">Charge</a> takes effect, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>HH</i> is 1.5 if the attacker's ally in a <a href="/wiki/Double_Battle" title="Double Battle">Double Battle</a> has used <a href="/wiki/Helping_Hand_(move)" title="Helping Hand (move)">Helping Hand</a> on it, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types and 1 if otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Type1</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's first type (or only type, if it only has a single type). This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), or 2 (super effective). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Struggle_(move)" title="Struggle (move)">Struggle</a>, <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a>, <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Doom_Desire_(move)" title="Doom Desire (move)">Doom Desire</a>, both <i>Type1</i> and <i>Type2</i> are always 1.</li>
<li><i>Type2</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's second type. This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), or 2 (super effective). If the target only has a single type, <i>Type2</i> is 1.</li>
<li><i>random</i> is realized as a multiplication by a random uniformly distributed integer between 85 and 100 (inclusive), followed by an integer division by 100.  <i>random</i> is always 1 if <a href="/wiki/Spit_Up_(move)" title="Spit Up (move)">Spit Up</a> is used.</li></ul>

<p>where:
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon. If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>Level</i> is instead the level of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, negative Attack or Special Attack stat stages are ignored). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>A</i> is instead the base Attack of the Pokémon performing the strike.</li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, positive Defense or Special Defense stat stages are ignored). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, <i>D</i> is instead the base Defense of the target.</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the effective <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>Burn</i> is 0.5 if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a>, its Ability is not <a href="/wiki/Guts_(Ability)" title="Guts (Ability)">Guts</a>, and the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Screen</i> is 0.5 if the used move is physical and <a href="/wiki/Reflect_(move)" title="Reflect (move)">Reflect</a> is present on the target's side of the field, or special and <a href="/wiki/Light_Screen_(move)" title="Light Screen (move)">Light Screen</a> is present. For a <a href="/wiki/Double_Battle" title="Double Battle">Double Battle</a>, <i>Screen</i> is instead 2/3; however, if in a Double Battle when the move is executed, the only Pokémon on the target's side of the field is the target (for moves with only one target), or there is only one target when the move is executed (for moves with more than one target), <i>Screen</i> remains as 0.5. <i>Screen</i> is 1 otherwise or if the used move lands a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>.</li>
<li><i>Targets</i> is 0.75 in <a href="/wiki/Double_Battle" title="Double Battle">Double Battles</a> if the used move <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_target_all_adjacent_foes" title="Category:Moves that target all adjacent foes">has more than</a> <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_target_all_adjacent_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Category:Moves that target all adjacent Pokémon">one target</a> (provided there is more than one such target when the move is executed, regardless of whether the move actually hits or can hit all the targets), and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 1.5 if a <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water-type</a> move is being used during <a href="/wiki/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a> move during <a href="/wiki/Harsh_sunlight" title="Harsh sunlight">harsh sunlight</a>, and 0.5 if a Water-type move is used during harsh sunlight or a Fire-type move during rain, or <a href="/wiki/SolarBeam_(move)" class="mw-redirect" title="SolarBeam (move)">SolarBeam</a> during any non-clear weather besides harsh sunlight, and 1 otherwise or if any Pokémon on the field have the Ability <a href="/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability)" title="Cloud Nine (Ability)">Cloud Nine</a> or <a href="/wiki/Air_Lock_(Ability)" title="Air Lock (Ability)">Air Lock</a>.</li>
<li><i>FF</i> is 1.5 if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a>, and the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Flash_Fire_(Ability)" title="Flash Fire (Ability)">Flash Fire</a> that has been activated by a Fire-type move, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 2 for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, 3 if the move lands a critical hit and the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Sniper_(Ability)" title="Sniper (Ability)">Sniper</a>, and 1 otherwise. It is always 1 if <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a> or <a href="/wiki/Doom_Desire_(move)" title="Doom Desire (move)">Doom Desire</a> is used, the target's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Battle_Armor_(Ability)" title="Battle Armor (Ability)">Battle Armor</a> or <a href="/wiki/Shell_Armor_(Ability)" title="Shell Armor (Ability)">Shell Armor</a>, the target is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Lucky_Chant_(move)" title="Lucky Chant (move)">Lucky Chant</a>, or if the battle is the first one against <a href="/wiki/Starly_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Starly (Pokémon)">Starly</a><b><sup class="noexcerpt"><a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Diamond_and_Pearl_Versions" title="Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Versions"><span style="color:#90BEED;">D</span><span style="color:#DD7CB1;">P</span></a></sup></b>.</li>
<li><i>Item</i> is 1.3 if the attacker is holding a <a href="/wiki/Life_Orb" title="Life Orb">Life Orb</a>, <math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>n</mi></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> if the attacker is holding a <a href="/wiki/Metronome_(item)" title="Metronome (item)">Metronome</a>, where <i>n</i> is the amount of times the same move has been successfully and consecutively used, up to 10, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>First</i> is 1.5 if the used move was stolen with <a href="/wiki/Me_First" class="mw-redirect" title="Me First">Me First</a>.</li>
<li><i>random</i> is realized a random integer from 85 to 100, inclusive, divided by 100. <i>random</i> is always 1 if <a href="/wiki/Spit_Up_(move)" title="Spit Up (move)">Spit Up</a> is used.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, 2 if the user of the move additionally has <a href="/wiki/Adaptability_(Ability)" title="Adaptability (Ability)">Adaptability</a>, and 1 if otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Type1</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's first type (or only type, if it only has a single type). This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), or 2 (super effective). If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Struggle_(move)" title="Struggle (move)">Struggle</a>, <a href="/wiki/Future_Sight_(move)" title="Future Sight (move)">Future Sight</a>, <a href="/wiki/Beat_Up_(move)" title="Beat Up (move)">Beat Up</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Doom_Desire_(move)" title="Doom Desire (move)">Doom Desire</a>, both <i>Type1</i> and <i>Type2</i> are always 1.</li>
<li><i>Type2</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type_effectiveness" class="mw-redirect" title="Type effectiveness">type effectiveness</a> of the used move against the target's second type. This can be 0.5 (not very effective), 1 (normally effective), or 2 (super effective). If the target only has a single type, <i>Type2</i> is 1.</li>
<li><i>SRF</i> is 0.75 if the used move is super effective, the target's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Solid_Rock_(Ability)" title="Solid Rock (Ability)">Solid Rock</a> or <a href="/wiki/Filter_(Ability)" title="Filter (Ability)">Filter</a>, and the attacker's Ability is not <a href="/wiki/Mold_Breaker_(Ability)" title="Mold Breaker (Ability)">Mold Breaker</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>EB</i> is 1.2 if the used move is super effective and the attacker is holding an <a href="/wiki/Expert_Belt" title="Expert Belt">Expert Belt</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>TL</i> is 2 if the used move is not very effective and the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Tinted_Lens_(Ability)" title="Tinted Lens (Ability)">Tinted Lens</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Berry</i> is 0.5 if the used move is super effective and the target is holding the <a href="/wiki/Category:Damage-reducing_Berries" title="Category:Damage-reducing Berries">Berry that weakens it</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Normal_(type)" title="Normal (type)">Normal-type</a> and the target is holding a <a href="/wiki/Chilan_Berry" title="Chilan Berry">Chilan Berry</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li></ul>

<p>where
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (ignoring negative stat stages for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>).</li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_use_stats_from_different_categories" title="Category:Moves that use stats from different categories">special move that uses the target's Defense stat</a>, or the effective Special Defense of the target if the used move is an other <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (ignoring positive stat stages for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>).</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the effective <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>Targets</i> is 0.75 (0.5 in <a href="/wiki/Battle_Royal" title="Battle Royal">Battle Royals</a>) if the move has more than one <a href="/wiki/Range" title="Range">target</a> when the move is executed, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>PB</i> is 0.25 (0.5 in <a href="/wiki/Generation_VI" title="Generation VI">Generation VI</a>) if the move is the second strike of <a href="/wiki/Parental_Bond_(Ability)" title="Parental Bond (Ability)">Parental Bond</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 1.5 if a <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water-type</a> move is being used during <a href="/wiki/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a> move or <a href="/wiki/Hydro_Steam_(move)" title="Hydro Steam (move)">Hydro Steam</a> during <a href="/wiki/Harsh_sunlight" title="Harsh sunlight">harsh sunlight</a>, and 0.5 if a Water-type move (besides Hydro Steam) is used during harsh sunlight or a Fire-type move during rain, and 1 otherwise or if any Pokémon on the field have the Ability <a href="/wiki/Cloud_Nine_(Ability)" title="Cloud Nine (Ability)">Cloud Nine</a> or <a href="/wiki/Air_Lock_(Ability)" title="Air Lock (Ability)">Air Lock</a>.</li>
<li><i>GlaiveRush</i> is 2 if the target used the move <a href="/wiki/Glaive_Rush_(move)" title="Glaive Rush (move)">Glaive Rush</a> in the previous turn, or 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 1.5 (2 in <a href="/wiki/Generation_V" title="Generation V">Generation V</a>) for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, and 1 otherwise. Decimals are rounded down to the nearest integer. It is always 1 if the target's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Battle_Armor_(Ability)" title="Battle Armor (Ability)">Battle Armor</a> or <a href="/wiki/Shell_Armor_(Ability)" title="Shell Armor (Ability)">Shell Armor</a> or if the target is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Lucky_Chant_(move)" title="Lucky Chant (move)">Lucky Chant</a>.
<ul><li>Conversely, unless critical hits are prevented entirely by one of the above effects, <i>Critical</i> will always be 1.5 (or 2 in Generation V) if the used move is <a href="/wiki/Storm_Throw_(move)" title="Storm Throw (move)">Storm Throw</a>, <a href="/wiki/Frost_Breath_(move)" title="Frost Breath (move)">Frost Breath</a>, <a href="/wiki/Zippy_Zap_(move)" title="Zippy Zap (move)">Zippy Zap</a>, <a href="/wiki/Surging_Strikes_(move)" title="Surging Strikes (move)">Surging Strikes</a>, <a href="/wiki/Wicked_Blow_(move)" title="Wicked Blow (move)">Wicked Blow</a>, or <a href="/wiki/Flower_Trick_(move)" title="Flower Trick (move)">Flower Trick</a>, the target is <a href="/wiki/Poison_(status_condition)" title="Poison (status condition)">poisoned</a> and the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Merciless_(Ability)" title="Merciless (Ability)">Merciless</a>, or if the user is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Laser_Focus_(move)" title="Laser Focus (move)">Laser Focus</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>random</i> is a random factor. Namely, it is recognized as a multiplication from a random integer between 85 and 100, inclusive, then floor divided by 100.
<ul><li>If the battle is taking place as a <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9star_Studios" title="Pokéstar Studios">Pokéstar Studios</a> film, <i>random</i> is always 1.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, 2 if the user of the move additionally has <a href="/wiki/Adaptability_(Ability)" title="Adaptability (Ability)">Adaptability</a>, and 1 otherwise or if the attacker and/or used move is <a href="/wiki/Typeless" class="mw-redirect" title="Typeless">typeless</a>. If the used move is a combination Pledge move, <i>STAB</i> is always 1.5 (or 2 if the user's Ability is Adaptability). When <a href="/wiki/Terastal_phenomenon" title="Terastal phenomenon">Terastallized</a>, <i>STAB</i> is (if not 1):
<ul><li>1.5 if the move's type matches either the Pokemon's original type(s) or a different Tera Type from its original types, and the attacker's Ability is not Adaptability.</li>
<li>2 if the move's type matches the same Tera Type as one of the Pokemon's original types and the attacker's Ability is not Adaptability, or the situation above, if the attacker's Ability is Adaptability.
<ul><li>However, if STAB only applies from the attacker's original type(s), not its Tera Type, <i>STAB</i> will always be 1.5, even if the attacker's Ability is Adaptability.</li></ul></li>
<li>2.25 if the move's type matches the same Tera Type as one of the Pokemon's original types and the attacker's Ability is Adaptability.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Type</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type#Type_effectiveness" title="Type">type effectiveness</a>. This can be 0.125, 0.25, 0.5 (not very effective); 1 (normally effective); 2, 4, or 8 (super effective), depending on both the move's and target's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">types</a>. The 0.125 and 8 can potentially be obtained on a Pokémon under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Forest%27s_Curse_(move)" title="Forest's Curse (move)">Forest's Curse</a> or <a href="/wiki/Trick-or-Treat_(move)" title="Trick-or-Treat (move)">Trick-or-Treat</a>. If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Struggle_(move)" title="Struggle (move)">Struggle</a> or <a href="/wiki/Typeless" class="mw-redirect" title="Typeless">typeless</a> <a href="/wiki/Revelation_Dance_(move)" title="Revelation Dance (move)">Revelation Dance</a>, or the target is typeless, <i>Type</i> is always 1. Decimals are rounded down to the nearest integer. Certain effects can modify this, namely:
<ul><li>If the target is an <a href="/wiki/Grounded" title="Grounded">ungrounded</a> <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying-type</a> that is not being grounded by any other effect and is holding an <a href="/wiki/Iron_Ball" title="Iron Ball">Iron Ball</a> or under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Thousand_Arrows_(move)" title="Thousand Arrows (move)">Thousand Arrows</a>, <i>Type</i> is equal to 1.</li>
<li>If the target is a <a href="/wiki/Grounded" title="Grounded">grounded</a> <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying-type</a> (unless grounded by an Iron Ball or Thousand Arrows, as above), treat <a href="/wiki/Ground_(type)" title="Ground (type)">Ground</a>'s matchup against Flying as 1.</li>
<li>If the target is holding a <a href="/wiki/Ring_Target" title="Ring Target">Ring Target</a> and the used move is of a type it would otherwise be immune to, treat that particular type matchup as 1.</li>
<li>If the attacker's Ability is <a href="/wiki/Scrappy_(Ability)" title="Scrappy (Ability)">Scrappy</a>, treat <a href="/wiki/Normal_(type)" title="Normal (type)">Normal</a> and <a href="/wiki/Fighting_(type)" title="Fighting (type)">Fighting</a>'s type matchups against <a href="/wiki/Ghost_(type)" title="Ghost (type)">Ghost</a> as 1.</li>
<li>If the target is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Foresight_(move)" title="Foresight (move)">Foresight</a>, <a href="/wiki/Odor_Sleuth_(move)" title="Odor Sleuth (move)">Odor Sleuth</a> or <a href="/wiki/Miracle_Eye_(move)" title="Miracle Eye (move)">Miracle Eye</a>, and the target is of a type that would otherwise grant immunity to the used move, treat that particular type matchup as 1.</li>
<li>If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Freeze-Dry_(move)" title="Freeze-Dry (move)">Freeze-Dry</a>, treat the move's type's matchup against <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water</a> as 2.</li>
<li>If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Flying_Press_(move)" title="Flying Press (move)">Flying Press</a>, consider both the move's type effectiveness and the <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying</a> type's against the target, and multiply them together.</li>
<li>If <a href="/wiki/Strong_winds" title="Strong winds">strong winds</a> are in effect and the used move would be super effective against <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying</a>, treat the type matchup against Flying as 1 instead.</li>
<li>If the target is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Tar_Shot_(move)" title="Tar Shot (move)">Tar Shot</a> and the used move is <a href="/wiki/Fire_(type)" title="Fire (type)">Fire-type</a>, multiply <i>Type</i> by 2.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Burn</i> is 0.5 if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a>, its Ability is not <a href="/wiki/Guts_(Ability)" title="Guts (Ability)">Guts</a>, and the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a> (other than <a href="/wiki/Facade_(move)" title="Facade (move)">Facade</a> from <a href="/wiki/Generation_VI" title="Generation VI">Generation VI</a> onward), and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>other</i> is 1 in most cases, and a different multiplier when specific interactions of moves, Abilities, or items take effect, in this order (and if multiple moves, Abilities, or items take effect, they do so in the order of the out-of-battle <a href="/wiki/Stat#Speed" title="Stat">Speed</a> stats of the Pokémon with them):</li></ul>

<dl><dd>If multiple effects influence the <i>other</i> value, their values stack multiplicatively, in the order listed above. This is done by starting at 4096, multiplying it by each number above in the order listed above, and rounding to the nearest integer whenever the result is not an integer (rounding up at 0.5). When the final value is obtained, it is divided by 4096, and this becomes <i>other</i>. For example, if both <a href="/wiki/Multiscale_(Ability)" title="Multiscale (Ability)">Multiscale</a> and a <a href="/wiki/Chilan_Berry" title="Chilan Berry">Chilan Berry</a> take effect, <i>other</i> is <math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>4</mn><mn>0</mn><mn>9</mn><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>4</mn><mn>0</mn><mn>9</mn><mn>6</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> = 0.25.</dd></dl>
<ul><li><i>ZMove</i> is 0.25 if the move is a <a href="/wiki/Z-Move" title="Z-Move">Z-Move</a> or <a href="/wiki/Max_Move" title="Max Move">Max Move</a> and the target would be <a href="/wiki/Protection" title="Protection">protected</a> from that move (e.g. by <a href="/wiki/Protect_(move)" title="Protect (move)">Protect</a>), and 1 otherwise. (If this multiplier is applied, a message is displayed that the target "couldn't fully protect" itself.)</li>
<li><i>TeraShield</i> is applied in <a href="/wiki/Tera_Raid_Battle" title="Tera Raid Battle">Tera Raid Battles</a> when the Raid boss's shield is active. It is 0.2 if the player's Pokémon is not <a href="/wiki/Terastal_phenomenon" title="Terastal phenomenon">Terastallized</a>, 0.35 if it is but the used move is not of its Tera Type, and 0.75 if it is and the used move is of its Tera Type. The result is subject to standard rounding (rounding up at 0.5).</li></ul>
<p>In the first four generations, during the calculation, all operations are carried out on integers internally—this means that all division operations are <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rounding#Rounding_to_integer" class="extiw" title="wp:Rounding">truncated integer division</a> (i.e. rounding down if the result is not an integer), and the results of multiplication operations are rounded down afterwards (truncating any fractional part). From <a href="/wiki/Generation_V" title="Generation V">Generation V</a> onward, there are three different types of rounding; a <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floor_(function)" class="extiw" title="wp:Floor (function)">flooring</a> (the same as previous generations), rounding to the nearest integer while rounding down at 0.5, and rounding to the nearest integer while rounding up at 0.5.
</p><p>If the calculation yields 0, the move will deal 1 HP damage instead (unless <i>Type</i> is equal to 0, in which case damage calculation is skipped entirely); however, in Generation V, a move may deal 0 damage when <i>other</i> is less than 1, because the routine to prevent 0 damage is erroneously performed before applying the <i>other</i> factor.
</p>
<div id="AdThrive_Content_3_desktop" class="adthrive-ad  adthrive-content adthrive-content-3" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h4><span class="mw-headline" id="Example">Example</span></h4>
<p>Imagine a <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> 75 <a href="/wiki/Glaceon_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Glaceon (Pokémon)">Glaceon</a> that does not suffer a <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burn</a> and holds no <a href="/wiki/Item" title="Item">item</a> with an effective Attack stat of 123 uses <a href="/wiki/Ice_Fang_(move)" title="Ice Fang (move)">Ice Fang</a> (an <a href="/wiki/Ice_(type)" title="Ice (type)">Ice-type</a> <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a> with a <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of 65) against a <a href="/wiki/Garchomp_(Pok%C3%A9mon)" title="Garchomp (Pokémon)">Garchomp</a> with an effective Defense stat of 163 in <a href="/wiki/Generation_VI" title="Generation VI">Generation VI</a>, and does not land a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>. Then, the move will receive <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">STAB</a>, because Glaceon's Ice type matches the move's: <i>STAB</i> = 1.5. Additionally, Garchomp is <a href="/wiki/Dragon_(type)" title="Dragon (type)">Dragon</a>/<a href="/wiki/Ground_(type)" title="Ground (type)">Ground</a>, and therefore has a double weakness to the move's Ice type: <i>Type</i> = 4. All other (non-random) modifiers will be 1. This effectively gives

<h3><span id="Pok.C3.A9mon_Legends:_Arceus"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="Pokémon_Legends:_Arceus">Pokémon Legends: Arceus</span></h3>
<p>In <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Legends:_Arceus" title="Pokémon Legends: Arceus">Pokémon Legends: Arceus</a>, a new damage calculation method<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> is used:
</p><p>All multiplications and divisions are rounded down to the nearest integer unless specified.
</p>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>D</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mn>0</mn><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>L</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo lspace="0" rspace="0">/</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mi>D</mi><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>k</mi><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>D</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>O</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>s</mi></mstyle></mrow></math></dd>
<dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>O</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>s</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mi>W</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>l</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>B</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>F</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>b</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>D</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>F</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>O</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>F</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>D</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>d</mi></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a>.
<ul><li>If the attacker is under <a href="/wiki/Slow_Start_(Ability)" title="Slow Start (Ability)">Slow Start</a>, then the physical Attack stat will be halved at this step of the calculation.</li>
<li>If the attacker is filled with Wild Might or Terrible Might, both Attack stats will be multiplied by 1.5.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Defense of the target if the used move is an other <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a>.
<ul><li>If the target is filled with Wild Might or Terrible Might, both Defense stats will be multiplied by 1.5.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.</li>
<li><i>AtkMod</i> is 1.5 if the attacker's offensive stats are boosted, 1 if they are neutral, or 0.66 if they are lowered. If the attacker and target have the same "stage" of offensive and defensive stats, both this and <i>DefMod</i> are 1. This is applied by first multiplying <i>AtkMod</i> by <i>DefMod</i>, then multiplying the result by the calculated damage thus far and rounding down to the nearest integer.</li>
<li><i>DefMod</i> is 1.5 if the target's defensive stats are lowered, 1 if they are neutral, or 0.66 if they are boosted.</li>
<li><i>random</i> is realized as a multiplication by a random integer between 85 and 100 (inclusive), and divided by 100.
<ul><li>Splinter damage (from <a href="/wiki/Ceaseless_Edge_(move)" title="Ceaseless Edge (move)">Ceaseless Edge</a>, <a href="/wiki/Pin_Missile_(move)" title="Pin Missile (move)">Pin Missile</a>, <a href="/wiki/Spikes_(move)" title="Spikes (move)">Spikes</a>, <a href="/wiki/Stealth_Rock_(move)" title="Stealth Rock (move)">Stealth Rock</a> and <a href="/wiki/Stone_Axe_(move)" title="Stone Axe (move)">Stone Axe</a>) is not subject to this factor.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Type</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type#Type_effectiveness" title="Type">type effectiveness</a>. This can be 0.4, 0.5 (not very effective); 1 (normally effective); 2, or 2.5 (super effective), depending on both the move's and target's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">types</a>.</li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 0.75 if a Fire-type move is used during rain, and 1 otherwise. The result is rounded to the nearest integer (rounding down at 0.5).</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 1.5 for a critical hit, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.25 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, and 1 otherwise. The result is rounded to the nearest integer (rounding down at 0.5).</li>
<li><i>BurnFrostbite</i> is 0.5 if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a> and the used move is <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical</a>, or if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Status_condition#Frostbite" title="Status condition">frostbitten</a> and the used move is <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Drowsy</i> is 1.33 if the target is <a href="/wiki/Status_condition#Drowsy" title="Status condition">drowsy</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>FixatedOffense</i> is 1.5 if the attacker is fixated, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>FixatedDefense</i> is 1.33 if the target is fixated, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Primed</i> is 1.5 if the attacker is primed, and 1 otherwise.</li></ul>
<div id="AdThrive_Content_4_desktop" class="adthrive-ad  adthrive-content adthrive-content-4" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h3><span id="Pok.C3.A9mon_Legends:_Z-A"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="Pokémon_Legends:_Z-A">Pokémon Legends: Z-A</span></h3>
<p>In <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Legends:_Z-A" title="Pokémon Legends: Z-A">Pokémon Legends: Z-A</a>, a damage calculation method similar to the one used from <a href="/wiki/Generation_V" title="Generation V">Generation V</a> onwards is used, though it does feature its own share of differences from it:<sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>All multiplications and divisions are rounded down to the nearest integer unless specified.
</p>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>D</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>L</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>D</mi></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>W</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>l</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>B</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>n</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>o</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>7</mn></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where
</p>
<ul><li><i>Level</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Level" title="Level">level</a> of the attacking Pokémon.</li>
<li><i>A</i> is the effective Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, or the effective Special Attack stat of the attacking Pokémon if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (ignoring stat drops for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>).
<ul><li>It is multiplied by ×1.5 if the user's stat is boosted, or ×0.67 if the stat is dropped.</li>
<li>It is multiplied by ×2 if the user's Trainer has a red <a href="/wiki/X_Attack" title="X Attack">X Attack</a> buff in the <a href="/wiki/Z-A_Battle_Club" title="Z-A Battle Club">Z-A Battle Club</a>.</li>
<li>It is multiplied by ×2 if the user is a <a href="/wiki/Wild_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Wild Pokémon">wild</a> <a href="/wiki/Alpha_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Alpha Pokémon">alpha Pokémon</a></li>
<li>It can be multiplied by ×1.1, ×1.25, or ×1.5 if Levels 1, 2, or 3, respectively, of <a href="/wiki/Donut#Flavor_Power" title="Donut">Attack Power</a> or Sp. Atk Power is active.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>D</i> is the effective Defense stat of the target if the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a> or a <a href="/wiki/Category:Moves_that_use_stats_from_different_categories" title="Category:Moves that use stats from different categories">special move that uses the target's Defense stat</a>, or the effective Special Defense of the target if the used move is an other <a href="/wiki/Special_move" title="Special move">special move</a> (ignoring a stat boost for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>).
<ul><li>It is multiplied by ×1.5 if the target's stat is boosted, or ×0.67 if the stat is dropped.</li>
<li>It is multiplied by ×2 if the target's Trainer has a blue <a href="/wiki/X_Defense" title="X Defense">X Defense</a> buff in the <a href="/wiki/Z-A_Battle_Club" title="Z-A Battle Club">Z-A Battle Club</a>.</li>
<li>It is multiplied by ×2 if the target is a <a href="/wiki/Wild_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Wild Pokémon">wild</a> <a href="/wiki/Alpha_Pok%C3%A9mon" title="Alpha Pokémon">alpha Pokémon</a></li>
<li>It can be multiplied by ×1.1, ×1.25, or ×1.5 if Levels 1, 2, or 3, respectively, of <a href="/wiki/Donut#Flavor_Power" title="Donut">Defense Power</a> or Sp. Def Power is active.</li>
<li>It can be multiplied by ×<math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math>, ×<math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math>, or ×<math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>6</mn><mn>5</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> if Levels 1, 2, or 3, respectively, of <a href="/wiki/Donut#Flavor_Power" title="Donut">Resistance Power</a> is active and the type of the used move matches the type Resistance Power guards against.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the base <a href="/wiki/Power" title="Power">power</a> of the used move.
<ul><li>It can be multiplied by ×1.1, ×1.25, or ×1.5 if Levels 1, 2, or 3, respectively, of <a href="/wiki/Donut#Flavor_Power" title="Donut">Move Power</a> is active and the type of the used move matches the type Move Power boosts.</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Weather</i> is 1.2 if a <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water-type</a> move is used during <a href="/wiki/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a>, 0.8 if a Fire-type move is used during rain, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Critical</i> is 1.5 for a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>, and 1 otherwise. It will always be 1.5 if the attack was landed as a sneak attack on an opposing Trainer's Pokémon in a <a href="/wiki/Z-A_Royale" title="Z-A Royale">Z-A Royale</a> or <a href="/wiki/Hyperspace" class="mw-redirect" title="Hyperspace">Hyperspace</a> <a href="/wiki/Battle_zone_(Lumiose_City)" title="Battle zone (Lumiose City)">battle zone</a>.</li>
<li><i>random</i> is a random factor. Namely, it is recognized as a multiplication from a random integer between 85 and 100, inclusive, then divided by 100.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.5 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, and 1 otherwise or if the attacker and/or used move is <a href="/wiki/Typeless" class="mw-redirect" title="Typeless">typeless</a>.</li>
<li><i>Type</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type#Type_effectiveness" title="Type">type effectiveness</a>. The multiplier can be affected depending on if a <a href="/wiki/Plus_Move" title="Plus Move">Plus Move</a> is used and if used against a <a href="/wiki/Rogue_Mega_Evolution" title="Rogue Mega Evolution">Rogue Mega Evolution</a> or equivalent boss battle. If a Plus Move is used against in a boss battle, the Plus Move multiplier is used.</li></ul>

<dl><dd><ul><li>Against a boss, 0.3× is applied to non-Plus Moves, and 0.63× is applied to super effective moves with a 4× or higher type multiplier.</li>
<li>The 0.15 and 8 (as well as the 0.18 and 10.4) can potentially be obtained on a Pokémon under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Forest%27s_Curse_(move)" title="Forest's Curse (move)">Forest's Curse</a> or <a href="/wiki/Trick-or-Treat_(move)" title="Trick-or-Treat (move)">Trick-or-Treat</a>.</li>
<li>If the target is typeless, <i>Type</i> is always 1; in Legends: Z-A, this is only used against the <a href="/wiki/Hyperrogue_Ange_Floette" class="mw-redirect" title="Hyperrogue Ange Floette">Hyperrogue Ange Floette</a> flowers, which are considered to be typeless.</li>
<li>If the attacker is a boss, and the target would otherwise be immune to the attack, <i>Type</i> is 0.3.</li>
<li>If the target is an <a href="/wiki/Grounded" title="Grounded">ungrounded</a> <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying-type</a> that is not being grounded by any other effect and is under the effect of <a href="/wiki/Thousand_Arrows_(move)" title="Thousand Arrows (move)">Thousand Arrows</a>, <i>Type</i> is equal to 1.</li>
<li>If the target is a <a href="/wiki/Grounded" title="Grounded">grounded</a> <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying-type</a> (unless grounded by an Thousand Arrows, as above), treat <a href="/wiki/Ground_(type)" title="Ground (type)">Ground</a>'s matchup against Flying as 1.</li>
<li>If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Freeze-Dry_(move)" title="Freeze-Dry (move)">Freeze-Dry</a>, treat the move's type's matchup against <a href="/wiki/Water_(type)" title="Water (type)">Water</a> as 2.</li>
<li>If the used move is <a href="/wiki/Flying_Press_(move)" title="Flying Press (move)">Flying Press</a>, consider both the move's type effectiveness and the <a href="/wiki/Flying_(type)" title="Flying (type)">Flying</a> type's against the target, and multiply them together.</li></ul></dd></dl>
<ul><li><i>Burn</i> is 0.5 if the attacker is <a href="/wiki/Burn_(status_condition)" title="Burn (status condition)">burned</a> and the used move is a <a href="/wiki/Physical_move" title="Physical move">physical move</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>other</i> is 1 in most cases, and a different multiplier when specific interactions of moves or items take effect, in this order:</li></ul>
<dl><dd><dl><dd><table class="roundy expandable" style="background: rgb(225, 225, 225); border: 3px solid rgb(218, 57, 20);">

</th></tr>

</td>
<td>If in effect on the target's side, the used move is physical (Reflect) or special (Light Screen), and the move is not a <a href="/wiki/Critical_hit" title="Critical hit">critical hit</a>.
</td></tr>

</td></tr>

</td></tr>
