<dl><dd>If multiple effects influence the <i>other</i> value, their values stack multiplicatively, in the order listed above. This is done by starting with 1, multiplying the multipliers together, multiplying the final multiplier by the result thus far, and rounding down the result to the nearest integer.</dd></dl>
<ul><li><i>Protect</i> is 0.25 if the move is a <a href="/wiki/Plus_Move" title="Plus Move">Plus Move</a> and the target would be <a href="/wiki/Protection" title="Protection">protected</a> from that move (e.g. by <a href="/wiki/Protect_(move)" title="Protect (move)">Protect</a>), and 1 if no protection is used. (If this multiplier is applied, a message is displayed that the target "couldn't fully protect" itself.)</li></ul>
<p>If the calculation yields 0, the move will deal 1 HP damage instead (unless <i>Type</i> is equal to 0, in which case damage calculation is skipped entirely).
</p><p>If the move would deal over 65535 damage, it will instead be capped at 65535; notably, this is different from in <a href="/wiki/Generation_V" title="Generation V">Generation V</a> to <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Scarlet_and_Violet" title="Pokémon Scarlet and Violet">Pokémon Scarlet and Violet</a>, where the damage instead would roll over to 0 at 65536.
</p>
<div id="AdThrive_Content_5_desktop" class="adthrive-ad  adthrive-content adthrive-content-5" style="min-height: 250px;"></div><h2><span class="mw-headline" id="In_the_spin-off_games">In the spin-off games</span></h2>
<h3><span id="Pok.C3.A9mon_GO"></span><span class="mw-headline" id="Pokémon_GO">Pokémon GO</span></h3>
<p>In <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_GO" title="Pokémon GO">Pokémon GO</a>, damage is calculated differently due to different variables existing in the game.
</p>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>D</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mi>M</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>m</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">⌊</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>w</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>A</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>k</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mi>D</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>e</mi></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">⌋</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where
</p>
<ul><li><i>Mushroom</i> is 2 if there is an active <a href="/wiki/Max_Mushrooms" title="Max Mushrooms">Max Mushroom</a> and is 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Power</i> is the power of the <a href="/wiki/Move_(GO)" title="Move (GO)">move</a> used</li>
<li><i>Attack</i> is the Attack <a href="/wiki/Stat_(GO)" title="Stat (GO)">stat</a> of the attacking Pokémon</li>
<li><i>Defense</i> is the Defense stat of the Pokémon being attacked</li>
<li>For <a href="/wiki/Shadow_Pok%C3%A9mon_(GO)" title="Shadow Pokémon (GO)">Shadow Pokémon</a>:
<ul><li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="false" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>6</mn></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> is applied to <i>Attack</i></li>
<li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="false" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> is applied to <i>Defense</i></li></ul></li></ul>
<p>and 
</p>
<dl><dd><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>M</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>f</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>y</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>T</mi><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>W</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>F</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>p</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>D</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>M</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>r</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>P</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>u</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>p</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>B</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>l</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>B</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>m</mi><mi>o</mi><mi>t</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>S</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi><mi>d</mi></mstyle></mrow></math></dd></dl>
<p>where
</p>
<ul><li><i>Type</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Type#Pokémon_GO" title="Type">type effectiveness</a>, which is calculated differently in GO, using multipliers of base 1.6 instead of 2.</li>
<li><i>STAB</i> is the <a href="/wiki/Same-type_attack_bonus" title="Same-type attack bonus">same-type attack bonus</a>. This is equal to 1.2 if the move's <a href="/wiki/Type" title="Type">type</a> matches any of the user's types, and 1 if otherwise.</li>
<li>The following variables are applied in <a href="/wiki/Gym_(GO)" title="Gym (GO)">Gym</a>, <a href="/wiki/Raid_Battle_(GO)" title="Raid Battle (GO)">Raid Battles</a>, and <a href="/wiki/Max_Battle" title="Max Battle">Max Battles</a> only, and are 1 otherwise.
<ul><li><i>Weather</i> is 1.2 if the move used has a <a href="/wiki/Weather#Pokémon_GO" title="Weather">weather-boosted</a> type, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>Friendship</i> is applied when battling with <a href="/wiki/Friends_(GO)" title="Friends (GO)">Friends</a> and varies depending on the Friendship level.
<ul><li>1.03 if Good Friends</li>
<li>1.05 if Great Friends</li>
<li>1.07 if Ultra Friends</li>
<li>1.1 if Best Friends</li>
<li>1.12 if Forever Friends</li>
<li>1 otherwise</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Dodged</i> is 0.25 if the attack was successfully dodged, and 1 if otherwise.
<ul><li>Gym defenders and Raid Bosses will never dodge a player's attacks</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Mega</i> is greater than 1 when there is one or more <a href="/wiki/Mega_Evolution" title="Mega Evolution">Mega-Evolved</a> Pokémon on the battlefield.
<ul><li>1.1 if none of the Mega-Evolved Pokémon have the same type as the move</li>
<li>1.3 if one or more Mega-Evolved Pokémon have the same type as the move</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Party</i> is 2 if the charge-move has been boosted by <a href="/w/index.php?title=Party_Play&action=edit&redlink=1" class="new" title="Party Play (page does not exist)">Party Play</a>, and 1 otherwise.</li>
<li><i>BehemothBash</i> is applied when the defender has the <a href="/wiki/Behemoth_Bash_(move)" title="Behemoth Bash (move)">Behemoth Bash</a> <a href="/wiki/Adventure_Effect" class="mw-redirect" title="Adventure Effect">adventure effect</a> and varies depending on the battlefield used
<ul><li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>1</mn><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> in <a href="/wiki/Raid_Battle_(GO)" title="Raid Battle (GO)">Raid Battles</a></li>
<li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mn>1</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> in <a href="/wiki/Max_Battle" title="Max Battle">Max Battles</a></li></ul></li>
<li><i>BehemothBlade</i> is applied when the attacker has the <a href="/wiki/Behemoth_Blade_(move)" title="Behemoth Blade (move)">Behemoth Blade</a> <a href="/wiki/Adventure_Effect" class="mw-redirect" title="Adventure Effect">adventure effect</a> and varies depending on the battlefield used
<ul><li>1.1 in <a href="/wiki/Raid_Battle_(GO)" title="Raid Battle (GO)">Raid Battles</a></li>
<li>1.05 in <a href="/wiki/Max_Battle" title="Max Battle">Max Battles</a></li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>The following variables are applied in <a href="/wiki/Trainer_Battle_(GO)" title="Trainer Battle (GO)">Trainer Battles</a> only, and are 1 otherwise.
<ul><li><i>Trainer</i> is 1.3 for all attacks used in a Trainer Battle.</li>
<li><i>Charge</i> is applied only for Charged Attacks, and its value depends on the player's score during the minigame. The possible ranges are
<ul><li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>C</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">=</mo><mn>1</mn></mstyle></mrow></math> if <i>"Excellent!"</i></li>
<li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>C</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">∈</mo><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>7</mn><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mstyle></mrow></math> if <i>"Great!"</i></li>
<li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>C</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">∈</mo><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>7</mn><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mstyle></mrow></math> if <i>"Nice!"</i></li>
<li><math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mi>C</mi><mi>h</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>r</mi><mi>g</mi><mi>e</mi><mo stretchy="false">∈</mo><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>2</mn><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mstyle></mrow></math> otherwise</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Shield</i> is 0 if an attack was protected by a <a href="/wiki/Protect_Shield" class="mw-redirect" title="Protect Shield">Protect Shield</a>, and is 1 otherwise.</li></ul></li>
<li>The following variable is applied in <a href="/wiki/Max_Battle" title="Max Battle">Max Battles</a> only, and are 1 otherwise.
<ul><li><i>Support</i> is applied when there are Pokémon placed at the <a href="/wiki/Power_Spot_(GO)" title="Power Spot (GO)">Power Spot</a>.
<ul><li>1.1 if 1 Pokémon placed (1 support icon)</li>
<li>1.15 if 2-3 Pokémon placed (2 support icons)</li>
<li>1.188 if 4-14 Pokémon placed (3 support icons)</li>
<li>1.2 if 15 or more Pokémon placed (4 support icons)</li>
<li>1 otherwise</li></ul></li>
<li><i>Spread</i> is 2 if the Max Battle Boss uses a single-target attack and is 1 otherwise.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p>By the damage formula, moves that have a power of 0 such as <a href="/wiki/Splash_(move)" title="Splash (move)">Splash</a> and <a href="/wiki/Yawn_(move)" title="Yawn (move)">Yawn</a> and moves shielded by <a href="/wiki/Protect_Shield" class="mw-redirect" title="Protect Shield">Protect Shields</a> will always do 1 HP damage.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Trivia">Trivia</span></h2>
<ul><li>In <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Ruby_and_Sapphire_Versions" title="Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions">Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire</a>, if the player's Pokémon deals over 33037 HP damage, the Pokémon will faint, but the HP bar will not be drained; if it deals exactly 33037 HP, the HP bar will be drained automatically.</li>
<li>In <a href="/wiki/Generation_V" title="Generation V">Generation V</a> onward, the amount of damage that can be dealt in a single attack is capped at 65535. In addition, an overflow can occur during the calculation of very high damage amounts, causing the actual damage dealt to be much lower than expected.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>In Generations I through IV, due to integer truncation, the multiplier <math class="mwe-math-element" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mstyle displaystyle="true" scriptlevel="0"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="INNER"><mo data-mjx-texclass="OPEN">(</mo><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mfrac><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">×</mo><mi>L</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>v</mi><mi>e</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow><mo stretchy="false">+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo data-mjx-texclass="CLOSE">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mrow data-mjx-texclass="ORD"><mn>5</mn><mn>0</mn></mrow></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mstyle></mrow></math> in the damage calculation increased at levels ending in 0, 3, 5, or 8.</li>
<li>In <a href="/wiki/Pok%C3%A9mon_Battle_Revolution" title="Pokémon Battle Revolution">Pokémon Battle Revolution</a>, the HP bar will change with a different animation depending on the move's type (recovery, <a href="/wiki/Recoil" title="Recoil">recoil</a> damage, and indirect damage use the Normal-type animation), as shown below.</li></ul>
